quests.title: The the Spot Course
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. A bloke near the Spot runs a ninety-minute course he bills at four hundred, and I've paid. I would not ask if there was anyone else about. Sit it Monday, then come back to Randwick and prove it did something. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: do the course they run near the Spot
then show me what it taught you

quests.title: Trouble at the Ritz cinema
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. Two lads and their mate decided at the change of shift that the Ritz cinema is theirs. I am aware how that sounds. The rest of Randwick disagrees, so explain the disagreement. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: sort the pair near the Ritz cinema
and the mate who joined in

quests.title: Counting the Randwick Ritz
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. Council says the the Randwick Ritz car park is never full and I say it's full by half four. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. Count both Randwick car parks, photograph whichever one makes me right. That's the whole job. No catch.

steps.label: count the cars at the Randwick Ritz
then the other car park
photograph the fuller one

quests.title: Proof of UNSW
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. Nobody in Randwick believes what UNSW looks like at half six. This is the third time I have had this conversation. Get me a photo close enough that council can't say it's somewhere else. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: get a picture of UNSW before they fix it

quests.title: One Stop From the Randwick Ritz
quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. I need to know the train from Randwick stops at Milsons Point and doesn't sail through like it did on Wednesday. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. Ride it at three in the morning and photograph the sign. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: take the train to Milsons Point
and photograph the platform sign

quests.title: Left It Near Belmore Road
quests.blurb: Keep it between us for now. I left something on the bench at Belmore Road at half four. It started small, the way these things do. By the time I got back to Randwick it had walked, so look where I'd have dropped it. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: check the bench near Belmore Road
photograph the bins behind it
tell me what you found

quests.title: Meat Tray at Belmore Road
quests.blurb: Before you say anything: yes, I know. The Belmore Road raffle is thirty-five short of a meat tray and the draw is at half six. It has been going on longer than I have admitted to anyone. Find it in Randwick and put it in the tin. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: raise thirty-five for the meat tray
and drop it at Belmore Road

quests.title: Staffy Near Coogee Bay Road
quests.blurb: This is going to sound small. A brindle staffy in a red bandana went over the fence at Coogee Bay Road at after the footy. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. Everyone in Randwick has definitely seen it and can't say where. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: check the off-leash bit near Coogee Bay Road
photograph the creek end
tell me if you saw a staffy in a bandana

quests.title: Race Four, Royal Randwick
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. There's a horse in race four at peak hour that a bloke at Royal Randwick swears by. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. Turn it into fifty-five somewhere in Randwick and tell me if it came in. Be polite about it. It costs nothing.

steps.label: turn the tip into fifty-five
tell me if it came in

quests.title: The the Prince of Wales Lift
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. The lift at Randwick station has been out since the Easter Show and I'm told Milsons Point is worse. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. Check both Boxing Day and tell me which takes a pram. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: check the lift at Randwick station
then ride to Milsons Point and check theirs
report which one works

quests.title: The the Prince of Wales Complaint
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. Two women in activewear have photographed my bins outside the Prince of Wales since Tuesday. It might be nothing. It has not felt like nothing. One has Randwick council on speed dial; sort it however you sort things. Half now if you want it. Most people don't.

steps.label: deal with the two of them near the Prince of Wales

quests.title: The the Ritz cinema Tab
quests.blurb: My knees are gone, so. Two chippies off the the Ritz cinema job have run a tab in Randwick since Saturday. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. They drove past at dawn without looking in, so settle it in cash. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: collect from the two chippies near the Ritz cinema
and bring back thirty of it

quests.title: Two From the Ritz cinema
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. Two of whatever's going near the Ritz cinema, here, hot, before the footy at bin night. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. It's Randwick; I'm not asking for much. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: pick up two from near the Ritz cinema
and get them here hot

quests.title: Something From the Ritz cinema
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. The stall at the Ritz cinema has run out and the customers keep coming. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Find something round Randwick that'll do before the five rush. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: pick something up near the Ritz cinema
bring it to the stall

quests.title: Rent Money, Anzac Parade
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. I'm forty-five short on the Anzac Parade rent and the agent doesn't take stories. I am aware how that sounds. Make it somewhere in Randwick by ten past ten; I'm not fussy how. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: earn forty-five somewhere in Randwick
